FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our services, process, and how we work together.

01

What services do you offer?

+

We design everything you need for your business: logos, websites, apps, Product and marketing materials. Need a new brand? We'll create it. Want a website? We'll build it. Looking for marketing designs? We've got you covered. You can pick and choose what you need most right now.

02

How does the Monthly Retainer subscription work?

+

Our Monthly Retainer subscription gives you access to our full creative team for a fixed monthly rate. You get unlimited design requests, daily support, and 48-hour turnaround on most tasks. It's perfect for growing businesses that need consistent creative output without the overhead of hiring in-house.

03

What's the difference between the Monthly Subscription and Quick Launch?

+

The Monthly Subscription is for ongoing creative needs with unlimited requests and daily support. Quick Launch is perfect for one-off projects like a single landing page, brand update, or specific campaign. Choose based on whether you need ongoing support or have a specific project in mind.

04

How soon can you start working together?

+

We can typically start new projects within 1-2 business days of your initial consultation. For urgent projects, we can often accommodate same-day starts depending on our current workload. We'll discuss timelines during our initial call to ensure we can meet your needs.

05

What do you need to get started?

+

To get started, we need a clear brief of your project goals, any existing brand materials, and your preferred communication style. We'll handle the rest! Our team will guide you through our streamlined onboarding process to ensure we have everything needed for success.

06

Can you work with tight deadlines?

+

Yes! We specialize in fast turnaround times. Our 48-hour standard turnaround on most tasks means we can handle urgent requests effectively. For rush projects, we can often deliver same-day results. We'll always be transparent about what's possible within your timeframe.

07

What if I don't have brand guidelines or a clear brand identity?

+

No problem! We can help you develop your brand identity from scratch. Our team will work with you to understand your vision, values, and target audience to create a cohesive brand that represents your business authentically. We'll guide you through the entire brand development process.

08

What platforms and technologies do you use for website development?

+

We work with modern platforms including Webflow, Framer, WordPress, and custom development. We choose the best technology based on your needs, budget, and long-term goals. Our team stays current with the latest tools and can recommend the optimal solution for your project.

09

How many requests can I make with the subscription?

+

With our Monthly Retainer subscription, you get unlimited design requests. There's no limit to how many projects or revisions you can request. We're here to support all your creative needs, from small tweaks to major campaigns. The only limit is our 48-hour turnaround time per request.

10

How do we communicate and collaborate during projects?

+

We use Slack for real-time communication, Loom for video feedback, and Notion for project management. You'll have direct access to your dedicated team and can communicate however you prefer. We also schedule regular check-ins to ensure everything stays on track.

11

How do I provide feedback on designs and deliverables?

+

We make feedback easy! You can comment directly on designs, send Loom videos, or use our Slack channels. We prefer detailed feedback to ensure we nail your vision, but we're flexible with whatever communication style works best for you. The goal is clear, actionable feedback that moves projects forward.

12

Do you handle copywriting, or do I need to provide content?

+

We handle copywriting as part of our complete creative solution! Our team includes copywriters who can create compelling content that converts. However, if you prefer to provide your own copy, we're happy to work with your content. We'll discuss your preferences during onboarding.

13

Can I pause or cancel my subscription anytime?

+

Absolutely! Our subscriptions are flexible by design. You can pause, upgrade, or cancel anytime with no penalties. We understand that business needs change, and we want to work with you when it makes sense. Just give us notice so we can wrap up any active projects properly.

14

What's your refund policy?

+

We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for new subscribers. If you're not completely satisfied with our service within the first 30 days, we'll provide a full refund. For ongoing projects, we work on a milestone-based payment system to ensure you're happy with progress before continuing.
